items.text: Grid semantics — category row headers, one focusable cell per row, aria-activedescendant, and row/column counts for screen readers.
Navigation keys — Home/End (category), Ctrl+Home/Ctrl+End (page), Page Up/Page Down; listed in the cheat sheet (!).
Custom font upload — upload .woff/.woff2/.ttf/.otf in General → Appearance; pick Custom font (uploaded) from the UI font dropdown.
Save → Open dashboard — after Save, the toast offers Open dashboard; returning applies pending settings via session sync.
Device-specific settings — cleaner merge of server vs. local visual preferences.
Dashboard i18n — footer/search ARIA, command labels (:pin, :note, …), bookmark row and inline-edit strings (EN / NL / DE / FR).
Phone vs desktop — new Help section and MANUAL table: search overlay tabs on phone; tag cloud, cheat sheet, and full config on desktop.
Guided tours — tour backdrop no longer blocks clicks; sticky save bar padding; default bookmarks ship with example tags.
Analytics cleanup — removed unused /api/analytics; use Config → Stats and /health for insights.
